title: Opportunity Oracle for DISTINCT_AND_EXACT components
basis: SB0_C0_PROFILE.json (OBSERVED A100 PUBLICATION-grade C0_V3_FINAL30K stage timings)

gate_thresholds.note: DROP if perfect upper bound <3% E2E OR realistic O_net <2% E2E. Implement only if realistic O_net >=3% E2E or a credible combination of exact components >=5% E2E.

evidence_class: OBSERVED (stage times) + HYPOTHESIS (upper-bound fractions, overhead, O_net)

components.name: Backward -> optimizer fusion (fused bwd+Adam)
components.perfect_upper_bound_basis: Conservative: optimizer kernel time only (eliminates separate Adam launch). Upside not counted: gradient write/read round-trip elimination.
components.transformation_overhead: MEDIUM: inline Adam into H8_MR backward kernel; STRIP n_touched==0 skip (prohibited #1); keep bias-correction status identical to C0 (none); re-validate m/v state parity + zero-gradient row parity (correctness gate).
components.realistic_onet_basis: Optimizer time scaled by fusion efficiency (~0.7-0.85 of optimizer kernel) minus kernel-rewrite risk; gradient-traffic upside on large-N scenes (bicycle/garden) pushes O_net up.
components.gate_reason: Realistic O_net >=3% E2E on bicycle (8-15%) and garden (6-12%); room borderline (3-5%) but multi-scene credible. Perfect upper bound (optimizer %) is 8.9/22.3/19.2% E2E, far above the 3% DROP line.
components.prohibited_risk: MUST strip invisible-Gaussian skipping (prohibited #1); MUST NOT change zero-gradient Adam semantics (prohibited #2); MUST NOT add bias correction (would change Adam semantics).

components.name: Two-stage (depth-based instance/bucket) sorting
components.perfect_upper_bound_basis: HYPOTHESIS: C0 single-pass tile sort ~= 40% of forward (rasterize_to_indices: count+scan+fill). Perfect-removal = new sort instant.
components.transformation_overhead: VERY HIGH: replace entire rasterizer addressing (instance/bucket buffers) + per-Gaussian backward + blob allocation. Effectively a rasterizer swap; risks changing the research problem.
components.realistic_onet_basis: On A100, C0 single-pass radix sort is already fast; Faster-GS two-stage benefit is mostly VRAM, not speed. After rasterizer-swap overhead, net speed gain is small.
components.gate_reason: Realistic O_net <2% E2E (0.5-1.5%). Perfect upper bound (~4.6-5.1% E2E) is above 3% but is eroded by very-high transformation overhead; not a credible standalone win. Coupled to C9.
components.prohibited_risk: Surgical port impractical; full swap risks changing the research problem.

components.name: Frontend allocation / densification memory handling
components.perfect_upper_bound_basis: Per-iteration allocation/launch overhead is small (~0.1-0.3ms); blob allocation mainly helps at resize, not every iter.
components.transformation_overhead: MEDIUM but LOW standalone value: blob buffers are coupled to the instance/bucket structure (C1); without C1 there is little to allocate.
components.realistic_onet_basis: Standalone per-iteration benefit <0.5% E2E; value only realized alongside C1 (which is itself DROP).
components.gate_reason: Perfect upper bound <3% E2E and realistic O_net <2% E2E. Coupled to C1 (DROP).

components.name: Morton/Z-order ordering of Gaussians + optimizer states (framework-layer)
components.stage: per-iter overhead + all stages (indirect locality benefit)
components.c0_stage_ms: N/A (framework-layer op; applied ~3x per 30K run: iters 5000/10000/15000)
components.perfect_upper_bound_ms: direct cost ~0.1-0.5% E2E (3 sorts of N~1M: morton_encode O(N)+argsort O(NlogN)+reorder O(N)); upside is INDIRECT locality, not a removable C0 stage
components.perfect_upper_bound_basis: HYPOTHESIS: the op itself costs time; the only upside is better memory locality for subsequent kernels, which is indirect and already partially provided by C0 tile-based sorting.
components.transformation_overhead: LOW-MEDIUM: framework-layer Python/torch change (morton_encode + stable argsort + joint sort of params AND exp_avg/exp_avg_sq). No CUDA rebuild strictly required, but optimizer-state migration must be exact.
components.realistic_onet_basis: HYPOTHESIS: direct cost is a net loss; indirect locality benefit on C0's already-coalesced tile-sorted access is small and uncertain. Fails the >=3% implement gate absent profiling.
components.gate_reason: Realistic O_net <2% E2E (uncertain indirect benefit, direct cost is a net loss). Fails the implement gate. Revisit ONLY if C7 underperforms or as a combination candidate after profiling C0 with/without Morton.
components.prohibited_risk: MUST permute param + exp_avg + exp_avg_sq rows together (pure permutation => no quality change); must not drop/reorder differently across param groups.

dropped_without_oracle.reason: C0 H8_MR backward is already per-Gaussian with absgrad.
Tighter bounds cull Gaussians -> quality change; prohibited. Default 3.33-sigma mode already C0-equivalent.
C0 already has fused Adam; bias-correction delta is a semantics change (prohibited #2).
Oracle run: NOT_SELECTED_THIS_ROUND (O_net<2%, uncertain indirect benefit). See components[].

combination_analysis.credible_combination: C7 alone passes; C8 (Morton) is a DISTINCT_AND_EXACT but uncertain secondary candidate (hold). C1/C9 DROP. No confident >=5% combination.
combination_analysis.note: No credible >=5% E2E combination exists because only C7 passes its individual gate. C7 alone already exceeds 3% on bicycle/garden, satisfying the implementation gate without combination.
combination_analysis.faster_gs_paper_speedup_note: Upstream Faster-GS wall-clock speedups are NOT usable as C0 O_net (task prohibition). All O_net here are derived from OBSERVED C0 stage timings.

final_oracle_verdict.next_gate: Before any CUDA change: (a) reconcile C0 binary/source sha256 with task-pinned hashes; (b) build independent Faster-GS reference worktree and reproduce Faster-GS on room (success criterion B); (c) then implement C7 in an isolated worktree with its own binary hash and pass the correctness gate (forward/gradient/one-step/m-v/zero-grad/densif parity).

success_criteria_status.A_c0_plus: PENDING (C7 is the sole candidate; requires implementation + correctness + performance gate)
success_criteria_status.B_stronger_external_baseline: PENDING (requires Faster-GS reference reproduction; source audit shows most components ALREADY_IN_C0, so a large quality/speed gap is not expected from these components alone)
